topic: Weekly fast fashion hauls vs a capsule wardrobe with a monthly clothing cap (Hubert vs Florence)

scenes.narration: Fast fashion hauls cost more than a quality wardrobe every year. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a mountain of shopping bags beside a neat rack of ten outfits, comic burst banner reads HAUL VS CAPSULE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hubert and Florence both love clothes and earn the same paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man hubert and woman florence each looking into a closet, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hubert orders a new haul almost every week, cheap and trendy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man hubert opening a box of flashy cheap shirts, a phone shows a cart of twelve items, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty dollars here, sixty there. It never feels like much.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, small receipts fluttering around man hubert like confetti, each reading THIRTY or SIXTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Half the pieces fall apart or go out of style in a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a shirt with a torn seam and a faded print, a trash bag of clothes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His year total, two thousand four hundred dollars of closet clutter.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading TWO THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, a closet exploding with clothes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Florence builds a capsule, twenty pieces that all match each other.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman florence arranging twenty neat pieces on a rack, arrows showing they mix and match, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sets a clothing cap of fifty dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman florence writing FIFTY A MONTH on a budget card, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She buys one quality item at a time, often secondhand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman florence at a thrift store holding a wool coat, a tag reads LIKE NEW, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her year total, six hundred dollars, and she loves every piece.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a scoreboard reading SIX HUNDRED, woman florence smiling in a sharp outfit, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hubert spent eighteen hundred more and looks worse. Florence looks sharp.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man hubert in a wrinkled trendy shirt, woman florence in a clean classic outfit, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twenty pieces that match beat two hundred that do not. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading BUILD THE CAPSULE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
